assumptions.decision: Source for 'no reading at all time' when the selected period is not all_time
assumptions.chosen: Second overview query with period=all_time, enabled only when the selected period is not all_time and has no activity
assumptions.why: calendar.reason NO_ACTIVITY_HISTORY exists only for all_time (statistics-calendar.composer.ts:144-152). Reusing the statistics key means 'Показати весь час' then renders from cache. assumptions.decision: Scope of removing the empty 'Поточна ціль' duplicate

assumptions.chosen: kpis.completedReads.value === 0 in the selected period; action depends on all-time completed reads from the S3-01 query

assumptions.chosen: reliableFrom <= accountCreatedDay + 1 day, with accountCreatedDay from UserView.createdAt in meta.timezone; no marking when createdAt is missing or invalid
